Gina Torres: Postmortem follow-up: metering late-ingest + duplicate writes caused invoice deltas. We need owners for: (1) a safe backfill that writes append-only adjustments, (2) a short-term deploy guard to prevent retry storms, and (3) customer credit process. Please claim items.

Leo Park: I'll own the backfill orchestration. Plan: leader-election, small batches, idempotent adjustment records with job_run_id and checksum. Will add a dry-run mode for BillingOps review.

Marta Silva: I'll own customer credits and communications. Need dry-run CSV and a short summary (invoice_id, delta_tokens, credit_amount).

Gina Torres: Proposed owners & dates (confirm):
- Leo Park 	 backfill job + PR 	 due 2026-04-10
- Marta Silva 	 invoice dry-run + credit memos 	 due 2026-04-12
- OpsRaj 	 deploy guard + metrics 	 due 2026-04-08
- Evan Chu 	 monitoring alert + dashboard 	 due 2026-04-09
Please ACK here.

BillingBot: ALERT: 19 invoices flagged in BILL-2488. Suggested flow: upload dry-run, legal review, apply adjustments.

OpsRaj: Short-term mitigation: adding a 3-minute post-deploy soft-throttle for metering writes and a retry-fingerprint TTL=30s. Will canary on staging today.

Leo Park: Backfill sketch and dry-run SQL I'll run:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(token_delta) AS delta_tokens
FROM metered_usage
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-04-01' AND event_ts < '2026-04-02'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(token_delta)) > 500;
```
Dry-run CSV path will be attached to BILL-2488.

Evan Chu: I'll add an alert for token-rate deviation > 20% and a dashboard comparing ingested events vs committed ledger rows.

Marta Silva: ACK. Once Leo uploads CSV, I'll draft credit memos and a customer FAQ. Legal review required for wording and SLA credit offers.

Leo Park: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/812 (backfill controller + dry-run). Includes leader-election using k8s lease and idempotent write semantics.

OpsRaj: Staging canary started at 14:05 PT. No retry spikes in the 30-minute window. Posting logs to BILL-2488.

Gina Torres: A few process rules: backfill must never mutate raw usage rows; write appendix adjustments. Keep per-invoice checkpoints and an operator approval step before bulk run. Add audit table with job_run_id, operator, and checksum.

Leo Park: Dry-run CSV uploaded: /private/drive/BILL-2488/dryrun_2478009999.csv (19 rows). Running canary adjustments on top-5 invoices now.

Marta Silva: Received CSV. Draft memos ready, routing to legal for approval. Will queue sending after signoff.

Gina Torres: Sync scheduled 2026-04-09 10:00 PT to review canary and approve bulk. If blockers appear, ping @Gina. Closing this thread until sync. :white_check_mark:
